ruleName: F1 Studio checkout - Preview-only rate limit (candidate)
description: Candidate thresholds only; observe real preview request traffic and confirm plan/billing before applying
activationGates: Capture a representative Preview POST /api/orders request-rate baseline without logging credentials or customer payloads
Check Vercel project plan and pricing dialog; confirm any additional charges before enabling
Assess multiple legitimate customers sharing a NAT / VPN IP
Verify scope is the exact Preview hostname AND Vercel environment preview
Run benign tests under the threshold, then controlled synthetic burst tests with no database writes
Only after reviewing false positives, choose 429 or challenge and document a rollback rule ID
Never apply to production without explicit user approval and separate production conditions

baseline.comment: Vercel active attack status returned no anomalies; this is NOT a rate distribution baseline.
